title: Hot Girl
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, Jan introduces a sales incentive program to Michael, who then reluctantly interacts with Katy, a handbag salesperson allowed to use the office conference room. Michael compares Katy to Pam and tries to help her integrate with the staff. Meanwhile, Jim reveals his preference for single moms and encourages Dwight to talk to Katy, leading to tension when Michael offers Katy a ride home, hinting at possible romantic interest. Dwight's attempt to ask Katy out is rejected, and Michael assigns Ryan to a special project. The episode explores office dynamics, relationships, and the impact of the new sales program.

main_threads.thread: Introduction and implementation of a sales incentive program by Jan and Alan, and Michael's involvement with Katy, the handbag salesperson allowed to sell in the office.

evidence.snippet: Jan: Alan and I have created an incentive program to increase sales.
Jan: At the end of the month you can reward your top seller with a prize worth up to a thousand dollars.
Pam: There's a person here who wants to sell handbags.
Michael (exhales loudly, looks out window and sees Katy): Oooh, alright I'll talk to her.
Michael: So uh, you know what? I usually don't allow solicitors in the office but today I am going to break some rules, and you can have the conference room. It's yours. All day.
Michael: Ah, Katy. Wow. Look at you. You are, uh you're like the new and improved Pam. Pam 6.0.
